read.thesis: Telecom quarter with capex held near $7B and leverage at 1.21x, but growth is consumer ARPU-led and supply discipline is only a flat budget, not a cut; no pricing or capacity inflection.

triggers.label: Capex held at about $7B
triggers.quote: we said $7 billion, 5% plus or 5% less,, and it is where we are

triggers.label: Mexico postpaid ARPU growth highest in 3 years
triggers.quote: our postpaid ARPU growth in Mexico in the quarter, is the highest that for the last 3 years at least

triggers.label: Televisa to buy AT&T Mexico assets
triggers.quote: Televisa is also gonna be a strong competitor

triggers.label: Prepaid revenue slowdown from registration mandate
triggers.quote: Maybe in the short term, we can have, like, a slowdown a little bit on the revenues on prepaid

guidance.quote: I think for next year, we are going to have the same, $7 billion, something like that.
we stated a leverage ratio that we intended to remain within, which was 1.5 to 1.4x, 1.2x to 1.5x

red_flags.label: Mexico broadband net adds sharply lower after base cleanup
red_flags.quote: So that is the reason why revenues are increasing and net adds are not as previous quarters.

red_flags.label: Prepaid base cleanup, 5M net disconnections
red_flags.quote: In the prepaid segment, we recorded 5 million net disconnections primarily reflecting subscriber based cleanups

evasions.quote: I do not remember the agreement but I do not remember the agreement that we have with NuCel.
I can lie to you if I can tell you what is going to be our price strategy next year.
